d:
Dr. Aaron Horschig, a physical therapist, details the rehabilitation journey of Olympic champion Ruslan Nurudinov. This video offers a step-by-step approach to addressing knee injury, providing valuable insights into effective physiotherapy / physical therapy techniques. Learn how we tackle knee pain and restore movement.
